lines.en: I swim slowly, and the water does too.

lines.zh: 浅色的鳞在浑水里也不显眼。
lines.en: My pale scales hide even in murky water.

lines.zh: 我们五条，慢慢荡过河湾。
lines.en: Five of us drift through the river bend.

lines.zh: 我贴着缓流走，不费力气。
lines.en: I ride the slow current without effort.

lines.zh: 河底的淤泥软，我不踩实。
lines.en: The river silt is soft, so I never quite touch it.

lines.zh: 我绕过一丛水草，草叶弹回。
lines.en: I pass a clump of weeds and the blades spring back.

lines.zh: 水面上的光晃得我舒服。
lines.en: The shifting light on the surface is pleasant.
One tail stroke slides me half a meter.
I remember every bend in this river.
Deeper water ahead, so I turn toward the shallows.

lines.zh: 沙地上有我的影子跟着。
lines.en: My shadow follows me across the sand.

lines.zh: 同伴散开，又慢慢凑回来。
lines.en: Schoolmates scatter, then drift back together.

lines.zh: 我游过桥墩投下的阴影。
lines.en: I pass through the shadow cast by a bridge pier.
Slow down, and the riverbed comes clear.

lines.zh: 我顺着水草边游，那里凉。
lines.en: I swim along the weed edge, where it's cool.

lines.zh: 河面有落叶漂下来，我躲开。
lines.en: A leaf drifts down; I slip aside.

lines.zh: 我的尾鳍一摆，只走半尺。
lines.en: One flick of my tail moves me half a foot.

lines.zh: 光线斜下来，我调了方向。
lines.en: The light slants down; I adjust my heading.
I hang in the slow water and let it sway me.

lines.zh: 阳光照到河底，一块一块。
lines.en: Sunlight reaches the bottom in patches.
I think nothing at all, and it is pleasant.
A leaf spirals down through the water.

lines.zh: 我的鳞是浅色的，像旧纸。
lines.en: My scales are pale, like old paper.
Two points of life are enough to live slowly.
The weeds sway beside me.
Someone is fishing in the distance.

lines.zh: 我把嘴张开，任水流穿过。
lines.en: Mouth open, I let the current wash through.

lines.zh: 同伴也不动，我们就这么待着。
lines.en: My schoolmates rest too; we simply stay.
The river is still except for its own sound.

lines.zh: 我等着一只虫掉进水里。
lines.en: I wait for some insect to drop in.
A small bubble rises from the silt.
I like afternoons like this.

lines.zh: 我抬头，看见你坐在岸边。
lines.en: I look up and see you sitting on the bank.
Your rod reaches out a long way.
Your shadow falls into the shallows.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，你看起来很闲。
lines.en: I do not fear you; you look unhurried.
You change bait with a light hand.

lines.zh: 我从水里看你，你在打哈欠。
lines.en: I watch from the water as you yawn.
Your bucket is empty; I noticed.
Your eyes are not really on the water.

lines.zh: 我们隔着半尺水面相望。
lines.en: We look at each other through half a foot of water.

lines.zh: 你笑了一下，我不知道为什么。
lines.en: You smile, and I do not know why.
Your hook tears my mouth.
In murky water my blood hardly shows.
The pain drives me into the mud.

lines.zh: 这一下让我半天回不过神。
lines.en: The hit blanks me for half a heartbeat.
A corner of my fin is torn open.
I struggle twice and cannot move.
You step on me and half of me flattens.
Two points of life do not take many hits.
I settle slowly down to the riverbed.
This one, I will remember a long while.

lines.zh: 那只虫掉下来，正好在我面前。
lines.en: That insect falls right in front of me.
Your bait sinks slowly down.
I drift over and sniff at it.
This would be my first bite today.
I am in no hurry; the water is slow.
The scent spreads wide through the water.

lines.zh: 我绕了半圈，还是回来了。
lines.en: I circle away, and come back anyway.
The worm looks soft.
My jaw opens a crack, then shuts again.
Let it sink a little more and I will eat.

lines.zh: 你涉水过来，水浑了一片。
lines.en: You wade in and the water clouds.
My flank touches your foot.
A schoolmate nudges me; I ease aside.
Your net brushes my dorsal fin.
I circle once around your legs.

lines.zh: 撞了一下，谁都没停下来。
lines.en: We bump, and neither of us stops.

lines.zh: 你踢起一团泥，我躲开了。
lines.en: You kick up a cloud of mud and I dodge it.
The ripple rocks me a little.
I scrape a stone and lose a scale.
Do not stomp about in the shallows.
When the water warms, I come near her.
We rest flank to flank on the sandy shelf.

lines.zh: 她那一身比我还白一分。
lines.en: She wears a paler white than I do.
I circle her, slowly.
The weeds screen us from view.
She touches my head.
Five schoolmates swim nearby.

lines.zh: 我们在沙上刨了个浅坑。
lines.en: We fan a shallow pit in the sand.

lines.zh: 卵沉进去，很快就看不见。
lines.en: The eggs settle in and soon vanish.
She leaves, and I stay where I am.
I take the bait and drag it slowly down.

lines.zh: 一粒小石子，我吐了出来。
lines.en: A small pebble; I spit it out.
I swim along with a strand of weed.
It is too heavy for me to tow.
I will not enter your bucket; it is crowded.
I hold the hook in my mouth, not swallowing.
I bump the bobber with my mouth.
Iron in my mouth is unpleasant.
I hold it a while, then release it.
You bend down, and I back away.

lines.zh: 水面破了一下，我看见了。
lines.en: The surface breaks and I see it.
Your shadow is closer than before.
I recognize that thin line.
My schoolmates suddenly sink lower.
Something stands up on the bank.
That shadow is no fallen insect.
I set my eyes on the hook.
I ease back behind the weeds.
Danger is here, and I have not decided to flee.
You move, and only then do I move.
I watch the hook and nothing else.
The line draws in a little at a time.
I measure how far off it hangs.
I creep closer along the bottom.
My fins lie nearly flat against my sides.
Your hand stops, and that is when I bite.

lines.zh: 我在等一个笨拙的动作。
lines.en: I wait for one clumsy move.
Half a foot, four inches, two.
I hide inside my own shadow.
I have thought about this bite for a while.
I bite the hook and drop.
My tail sweeps across your hand.
I bump your ankle, lightly.
My teeth are small, but I am stubborn.
I thrash and splash muddy water on you.
That bite did not hold.
You pull the line; I pull the other way.
Do not squeeze me; I bite.
I shake my head and the hook loosens.
Let me go; the water is still slow.
I open my eyes in the shallows.
Sunlight falls straight on me.
Five schoolmates already gather round.
My scales are pale from the very first day.
The water in the bend is gentle.
I flick my tail and ease forward.

lines.zh: 沙上留着我的第一道痕。
lines.en: My first track stays in the sand.
Water sounds come down from upstream.
This river has room for me.
I am in no hurry to grow.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我身上飘出香味。
lines.en: Fire sears me and a cooked smell rises.
I drop from the shallows onto stone.

lines.zh: 被捞出水面，我喘不上气。
lines.en: Pulled out of the water, I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 爆炸把河底的泥全翻起来。
lines.en: The blast turns up all the river mud.

lines.zh: 箭穿过水面，扎进我身侧。
lines.en: An arrow cuts the surface and strikes my flank.
Violet light wraps around me and I cannot move.

lines.zh: 好几天没吃，我瘦得发轻。
lines.en: Days without food leave me light and thin.

lines.zh: 雷落进河里，我整条都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the river and numbs me entirely.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有河，我一直在坠。
lines.en: There is no river in the void; I keep falling.
